# dnsgate_url_forward (Data Source)

The URL forward (HTTP redirect) of a name in a zone served by the gate, whoever owns it. Fails if the name has no forward.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "dnsgate_url_forward" "go" {
  zone = "example.com"
  name = "go"
}

output "go_target" {
  value = data.dnsgate_url_forward.go.url
}

output "forwards_answer_https" {
  value = contains(["active", "no_forward"], data.dnsgate_url_forward.go.https_status)
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name relative to the zone, `@` for the apex.
- `zone` (String)

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Meta description of a frame forward, empty otherwise.
- `hash` (String) Content hash (the ETag of the forward).
- `https_status` (String) Whether the forwards of the zone answer HTTPS: `active`, `pending`, `no_forward`, `inactive` (plain HTTP only), `unsupported`, `unknown`.
- `id` (String) `<zone>/<name>`, the import id of `dnsgate_url_forward`.
- `keywords` (String) Meta keywords of a frame forward, empty otherwise.
- `owner_team` (String) Owner team, empty when not owned.
- `status` (String) `managed`, `pending`, `tainted`, `foreign`, `missing`.
- `title` (String) Title of a frame forward, empty otherwise.
- `type` (String) `301`, `302` or `frame`.
- `url` (String) Target URL.
